summary: Pin elevation observed during canary steering leads to cross-tenant fallbacks
description:
Issue summary:
Support received multiple alerts from NovaHealth that after a canary steering adjustment earlier this week, a subset of user sessions previously pinned to their explicit model version were observed to 'elevate' to the canary variant. When the canary briefly failed health probes, those sessions immediately fell back to a degraded legacy variant, causing silent fallback behavior and degraded outputs for customer users.

Impact:
- Intermittent correctness regressions for ~0.4% of NovaHealth traffic during the steering window.
- Customer reports increased 5xx fallback responses and user-facing content degradation for a focused cohort (estimated 200–600 requests/hour).
- Billing spike risk from fallback cost differential and repeated retries.

Environment:
- Production (us-east) using Dedicated pool (enterprise contract).
- Canary steering rule applied at 2026-03-09 22:10 UTC targeting 10% of tenant cohorts.

Observed behavior:
- Traffic that previously honored explicit tenant model pin (redwood/v2-chat-8b) shows header-affinity tokens bound to the canary variant after steering change.
- When canary health transitions to degraded, those sessions are rerouted to a legacy variant (redwood/v1-chat-4b) rather than honoring the tenant pin or falling back to staged compatible variant as expected.

Expected behavior:
- Tenant-level explicit pins must remain authoritative; steering should only influence unpinned cohorts. If steering promotes a variant for unpinned cohorts, pinned sessions should not be re-pinned or promoted.
- On canary failure, fallback should choose compatible fallback variant per per-tenant policy and never cross-tenant-divert pinned sessions.

Steps to reproduce (internal repro):
1) Setup tenant config with explicit pin: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/NOVA/config -d '{"pin":"redwood/v2-chat-8b"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'
2) Apply a canary steering rule that increases steering weight for header X-Steer: tenant-cohort -> canary redwood/v2-chat-8b-canary at 10%.
3) Send 1k requests across two client sessions: one with tenant pin header and one without. Observe routing decisions in traces.
4) Flip canary health to unhealthy via orchestrator health override and watch pinned session routing.

Relevant logs / traces (sanitized):
- Edge trace (2026-03-10T02:14:03Z): routing_decision: {tenant_id: "NOVA", session_id: "s-09f3", prior_pin: "redwood/v2-chat-8b", selected_variant: "redwood/v2-chat-8b-canary", reason: "canary-steering-match"}
- Orchestrator (2026-03-10T02:15:10Z): fallback_trigger: {variant: "redwood/v2-chat-8b-canary", health_score: 0.18} -> selected_fallback: "redwood/v1-chat-4b", rationale: "fallback-on-unhealthy-canary"
- Audit (2026-03-10T02:15:21Z): pin_change_detected: {session_id: "s-09f3", new_affinity: "variant_affinity_token:canary-epoch-42"}

Notes:
- Customer asserts they did not change tenant pin config.
- Controls show steering was toggled by Product at 2026-03-09 22:10 UTC for broad experiment.
comments: 2026-03-10 Priya Desai (Support): Initial triage and acknowledgement sent to NovaHealth. Asked for traces and confirmation that tenant pin wasn't modified on their side.
2026-03-10 NovaHealth (Support Contact Laura Kim): Confirmed they did not change pin configuration. Provided sample request IDs and timestamps. Impacting dashboard linked in message.

2026-03-11 Aiden Chen (SRE): Reproduced promotion of affinity token in lab when steering rule present. Hypothesis: steering path currently canleverage session affinity token promotion logic and overwrite tenant pin in edge metadata.
2026-03-11 Sofia Martinez (Platform Eng): Noted orchestrator commit 4f8a2d introduced 'steering promotion' to preemptively warm canary; adding to investigation.
2026-03-12 Aiden Chen (SRE): Applied temporary mitigation: disabled steering propagation flag for NovaHealth cohort; monitoring for recurrence. Awaiting customer confirmation for impact reversal.
2026-03-12 Laura Kim (NovaHealth): Verified errors count dropped and fallbacks no longer hit legacy variant. Asked for root cause and timeline for fix.
investigation_notes:
Findings so far:
- Repro shows steering path sets a transient 'variant_affinity_token' that has higher precedence than tenant pin during routing decision. Edge prioritization logic treats affinity token promotion as an explicit bind. This is a regression introduced by orchestrator PR that aimed to reduce cold-starts by pre-binding warm canary KV caches.
- The promoted affinity token can survive into subsequent requests for the same session and is being honored even for tenants with explicit pins because precedence ordering checks only on token existence, not pin origin.
- Race condition: if promotion happens between the initial tenant pin check and final route selection, the affinity token wins.

Open hypotheses:
- A header normalization step in the ingress sidecar might be translating tenant pin headers into affinity tokens incorrectly in certain header combinations.
- Token TTL handling might be too long and not scoped to 'steering-only' sessions.

Relevant artifacts:
- Orchestrator commit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/orchestrator/commit/4f8a2d
- Trace collection: s3://redwood-traces/prod/2026-03-10/NOVA/s-09f3.log (internal link)
resolution_notes:
Temporary mitigation applied (2026-03-12): disabled 'steering promotion' flag for NovaHealth cohort and reverted steering propagation in edge-config for that tenant. Observed immediate reduction in cross-variant fallbacks.

Next steps (short term):
- Backfill a guard in the edge routing priority: if tenant pin present, ignore steering-affinity promotions (target: hotfix by 2026-03-15).
- Add integration test covering steering + explicit pin precedence (target: 2026-03-18).
- Scan recent orchestrator PRs for similar 'promotion' logic and create follow-up PR to centralize precedence rules.

Longer term:
- Add telemetry to classify affinity tokens by origin (pin, steering, prewarm) so routing decisions can be audited.
- Adjust token TTL semantics and ensure steering promotions are ephemeral and isolated to unpinned cohorts.

Owner: Aiden Chen. Expected permanent fix rollout: 2026-03-22 (can be accelerated if tests pass).
public_notes: We have applied a targeted mitigation for your account (NovaHealth) which removed the promotion behavior while we implement a safe precedence fix. We do not expect further user-facing regressions; our engineering team will notify when a permanent patch has been deployed.
